conversations: What is the speed of light?
The speed of light in a vacuum is approximately 299,792,458 meters per second (about 300,000 km/s).
How far is the Sun from Earth?
The Sun is about 149.6 million kilometers (93 million miles) away from Earth.
Gravity is a fundamental force by which a planet or other body draws objects toward its center.
What is the largest planet in our solar system?
Jupiter is the largest planet in our solar system.
Quantum mechanics is a fundamental theory in physics that describes the physical properties of nature at the scale of atoms and subatomic particles.
Photosynthesis is the process used by plants to convert light energy into chemical energy.
DNA (deoxyribonucleic acid) is the molecule that carries genetic instructions in all living things.
